mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal economic overheating that triggers policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with CPI above 2.5% signals aggressive policy action that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are above thresholds, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS grows and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.
